# Rebelway

> > Rebelway offers professional VFX training courses specializing in Houdini FX, Nuke compositing, and advanced CG simulation techniques.

Rebelway provides industry-leading online courses taught by working VFX professionals, covering everything from FLIP water simulations to destruction effects, fire simulation, and advanced asset creation in Houdini. The platform features hands-on training in tools like SideFX Houdini, Nuke, Solaris, Karma, and USD workflows.

## Key Topics

- Houdini FX and simulations
- SideFX Houdini workflows
- Nuke compositing
- FLIP water simulation
- Destruction effects
- Fire and smoke simulation (FumeFX)
- USD and Solaris pipeline
- Karma rendering
- Advanced asset creation
- Motion design
- Creature rigging
- After Effects integration
- Video Copilot Element 3D
- Professional VFX training
- Alumni success stories

## Course Catalog

- [Rebelway Courses | Compositing and FX in Houdini, Nuke, and More](https://www.rebelway.net/workshops): Main course catalog for Houdini, Nuke & VFX training workshops
- [Water FX in Houdini | A Professional VFX Simulation Course](https://www.rebelway.net/water-fx-in-houdini): 8-week FLIP water simulation course taught by Igor Zanic

## Free Lessons & Previews

- [Mastering Fx LVL2 - WEEK1 | Online VFX Course](https://www.rebelway.net/mastering-fx-lvl2-week1): Free lesson on advanced Houdini compositing from Advanced Asset Creation
- [City Creation in Houdini | Course Lessons](https://www.rebelway.net/fantasy-fx-in-houdini-preview-page): Free preview of Fantasy FX city creation course in Houdini
